# A `share_price:` that reaches a figure finer than the bank's currency.
#
# The twin of `settled_amount_finer_than_the_bank.txt`, stating the rate rather
# than the cash. 100 USD at 7.80005 is 780.005 HKD — the same unrepresentable
# figure, by the other documented spelling of the same fact.
#
# Checked only for "parses" and "positive", the rate gave a bank split rounded
# to 780.00 while the residual was computed from that rounded figure, so the
# entry balanced and the run reported `Errors: 0` about a payment the file did
# not describe. Worse than its twin: nothing then matched it either, because
# the comparison reads what the file says — 780.005 — against what the book
# holds, so the document was rebuilt on every import, forever.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming 780.005 and HKD's cent.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_amount_must_fit_the_currency.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:HKD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-RATE-FINE"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-RATE-FINE"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		share_price: 7.80005
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-RATE-FINE"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
